subject.title: [Bug]: Dreaming deep promotion biased to stale 3-5 day old content; REM produces repetitive meta-themes; promotion gates bypassed via phase-signal boost

question: Should this broad dreaming-quality report remain open as the umbrella, or should maintainers close it after designating narrower canonical issues for the remaining signal-policy and REM-noise work?
rationale: Current main refutes several exact root-cause claims, but source and production evidence still show a real memory-quality problem whose repair changes current tested promotion semantics.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle the shared dreaming promotion contract and use the narrower items for implementation details.

options.title: Close after canonical split
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers explicitly pick the canonical sibling issues and preserve this production evidence there.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle the shared dreaming promotion contract and use the narrower items for implementation details.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent semantic work on dreaming-only promotion makes this the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
